title: Contact
lead: Ready to begin? Book a free discovery call, or send a message and we'll find a time that works for you.
bookingText: Choose a time that suits you. Discovery calls are a relaxed, no-pressure way to see whether coaching feels right for you.
formText: Prefer to write first? Share a little about what brings you here and you'll receive a reply by email.
privacyNote: Your name, email, and optional phone number are used only to schedule sessions and reply to you. This information is kept confidential and is never shared with third parties.
